sloka: अथासाद्य तु काLइन्न्धीम् शीघ्रस्रोतसमापगाम् ।तस्यास्तीर्थम् प्रचरितम् पुराणम् प्रेक्ष्य राघवौ ॥२-५५-५॥
transliteration: athāsādya tu kāLinndhīm śīghrasrotasamāpagām ।tasyāstīrtham pracaritam purāṇam prekṣya rāghavau ॥2-55-5॥

translations.english: On reaching that swiftflowing river Yamuna, O Rama and Lakshmana O scions of the Raghu race, you will find an ancient spot (on the river bank). There make a raft and cross Kalindi, daughter of the Sun.
